purpose: Make actor responsibility machine-checkable: each route must identify the primary accountable actor, adjacent actors, burden bearers, beneficiaries, bottlenecks, fallback duties, evidence, and anti-misattribution rule.
special_rules: Profiles must mirror route family and source_currentness_refs.
Every profile must name at least one burden bearer and at least one non-responsible actor category.
Routes with private mandatory rail, bank-required, tax-software, digital-only, or protected-floor incidence must name a public fallback duty.
Penalty-like or willfulness-like routes must require control, duty, notice, and appeal evidence.

Tax-administration-access profiles must name the concrete beneficiary/rent recipient and route-specific evidence; generic beneficiary_or_rent_recipient_to_trace and benefit_or_rent_trace placeholders are not sufficient.

Controller-AI profiles must name the concrete beneficiary/rent recipient and route-specific evidence; generic beneficiary_or_rent_recipient_to_trace and benefit_or_rent_trace placeholders are not sufficient.

Public-finance-core profiles must name the concrete beneficiary/rent recipient and route-specific evidence; generic beneficiary_or_rent_recipient_to_trace, named_beneficiary_or_rent_recipient, and benefit_or_rent_trace placeholders are not sufficient.

Legal-enforcement-penalty profiles must name the concrete beneficiary/rent recipient and route-specific evidence; generic beneficiary_or_rent_recipient_to_trace and benefit_or_rent_trace placeholders are not sufficient, and coercive routes must preserve control, notice, willfulness/fault, privilege, owner/remedy, or contest evidence as applicable.

Labor-care-benefits profiles must name concrete beneficiaries, bottlenecks, and route-specific evidence; generic beneficiary_or_rent_recipient_to_trace, public_channel_owner-only bottlenecks, and benefit_or_rent_trace evidence are not sufficient for worker, care, household, education, pension, data, or platform-benefit routes.

Environment-climate-commons profiles must name concrete harm controllers, beneficiaries, bottlenecks, protected burden bearers, evidence packets, and fallback/no-go duties; generic beneficiary_or_rent_recipient_to_trace, public_channel_owner-only bottlenecks, and benefit_or_rent_trace evidence are not sufficient for environmental, climate, water, resource, insurance, transport, offset, or prefunding routes.
